description: Defines the ILifecycleManager interface and related structures for managing application lifecycle states within the WPEFramework Exchange namespace, including notification mechanisms and runtime configuration.

classes.name: ILifecycleManager
classes.description: Interface for managing application lifecycle states, notifications, and control operations such as spawn, unload, kill, and send intent.

classes.name: ILifecycleManager::INotification
classes.description: Notification interface for application state changes.

classes.name: RuntimeConfig
classes.description: Configuration structure for runtime environment parameters.

methods.name: GetLoadedApps
methods.description: Retrieve list of loaded applications with optional verbosity.

methods.name: IsAppLoaded
methods.description: Check if an application is loaded.

methods.name: SpawnApp
methods.description: Launch an application with specified runtime configuration.

methods.name: SetTargetAppState
methods.description: Set the desired lifecycle state for an application instance.

methods.name: UnloadApp
methods.description: Gracefully terminate and unload an application.

methods.name: SendIntentToActiveApp
methods.description: Send an intent to the active application.
